# Phase 3 golden evidence corpus

This sanitized corpus freezes the Phase 3 parser-neutral facts used by both
the ARC producer and standalone consumer tests. Its source contract is ARC
`tckdb-imp` commit `6efc4e12` plus the Phase 3 producer schema. Labels and
coordinates were reduced to a small H/H2 exchange example; paths are
run-relative; usernames, servers, job IDs, credentials, timestamps, and
irrelevant log text were removed. It retains a multi-atom Hessian, forward and
reverse IRC points, and a three-frame GSM path whose endpoint has no absolute
energy while interior nodes do.
